main.description: Scan mv_resource_flow_sankey_{currency,service,personnel} and flag (source × counterparty × period) triples whose observed event_count exceeds the rolling baseline by `thresholdFactor`. Writes to vertex_resource_flow_anomaly + emits T1 social posts to the rf-anomaly channel. Designed to be invoked by the R/PT24H BPMN timer; manual invocation is allowed for backtest. ADR-0028 + ADR-0046.

minBaselineSamples.description: Skip triples with fewer than N baseline rows to avoid cold-start false positives.

post.description: Emit T1 app.bsky.feed.post on the rf-anomaly channel for each new anomaly.
